translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: 1 Tesalonisiyen
book.title: 1 Tesalonisiyen Maktumne ta awalle taat Pool siirtu ɗo gee ku Tesalonik

content: Gem kol siŋtay, ɗo bi ka wiktiner iŋ ƴiriy taat *Rabbin Iisa yaa yeepe, ni ginno pey kaaw taat niiko siire.
Asaan kuŋ maaniiko iban tam kadar ƴiriy ta Rabbiner, taar yaa ase ar kokin ka aandor.

Ƴiriy-at yaa ase ɗo wiktin taat gee kaawa aman : « Hay, aapiy as kat ɗo darrer ho barjaalin sa ginno pey ! » Kar ɗo wiktin taar-at di, tala kar omaayin di galco ɗo kaƴco ar daatik taat enaw ɗo weenti ho wer kaak ŋuu imile kaƴco sa ginno.
Gem kol siŋtay, gee kuuk goy ɗo gondikor, ƴiriy ta Rabbiner yaaco soke yooma. Kar kuŋ gay arro gee ŋuur-aku.
Asaan, okiŋko, ku goy ɗo portikaw ho ku gina gamin kuuk kuuniya ƴiriyo. Yampa, gi goyɗo ɗo gondikor ho gi ginno gamin kuuk kuuniya aando di.
Ɗo taar-at ko, dakinte weƴenno ar ŋuura. Kar gay, goyinte mento ho gedirinte ɗo ziŋkite.
Asaan gee kuuk weƴaw, ŋuur weƴa iŋ aando, ho gee kuuk sakriyaw sa, ŋuur sakriya iŋ aando.
Kar ginte, gee ku portikaw gay, gii gedire ɗo ziŋkite. Imaan iŋ ele yaate gooƴinte ar saapine ɗo ziŋkite ho ere kaak gii ere jile yaate gooƴinte ar jakumne ta taasin̰kar ɗo kaƴte.
Gii gine ampa-ak, asaan Buŋ balinte doɓinte a ŋaate taaɓiyinte iŋ dapin̰koy. Kar gay, ŋa doɓinte a gii gase jile iŋ Rabbinte Iisa Masi.
Ŋaar kat mat ɗo bi kante. Paa ko, ya gi mate wala gi goy mento sa, ƴiriy taat ŋaa yeepe-ak, gii goye sawa iŋ ŋaara.
Ŋaar-ak, iskiguwoŋ ho ɗeŋirguwoŋ ziŋkiko ɗo imaanko ar kaak ku gingiyo.
Taaƴiika iŋ ooy ta ba aaro
Gem kol siŋtay, ni raka kuu karmiyin̰ gay riyor ku Buŋdi kuuk gina riy iŋ kuŋko. Asaan gee ŋuur-ak, Rabbin kat leeyig a ŋuu tale kaako ho ŋuuko taaƴiŋko.
Ɗo bi ka riy taat ŋu giniyo, elguwoŋgu ho berguwon̰co horoomin dakina. Kar kuŋ gay, dakoŋ giɗenno benanniko.
Gem kol siŋtay, nu kaawaako : leeson̰co ɗo gee kuuk zegilay, iskoŋ gee kuuk ƴiimit gartico, sosoŋ gee kuuk ginno gudurre
ho icoŋ subirraw iŋ gee okin̰co.
Yaman, goyoŋ goɗom, ya rakki minninko nigjiŋ, dakiy yeepenno. Kar gay, ginguwoŋ sellen̰ benanniko ho ɗo gee okin̰co.
Goyoŋ doo iŋ galal.
Indiguwoŋ Buŋ, dakoŋ peyenno.
Oziloŋ Buŋ ɗo ay maanna. Ŋuur-aŋ ko gamin kuuk Buŋ rakiy kuu gine ɗo goyiŋko kaak iŋ Iisa Masi.
Ya Ruwwin ta Buŋdi gina riyti ɗo gelbinko, dakonti toɗenno.
Ya Buŋ kaawko iŋ biŋka ku nabiinnar, dakoŋ poocin̰coɗo kaawinco.
Kar gay, ibinoŋ ja baaco ta gamin-aŋ okin̰co, kar kat, kuu obe ŋuur kuuk samaane.
Cimoŋ kaƴko min ay maan kaak samaanno.
Meen̰ji Buŋ ka aapiyer yaako giniŋko kuu kuuniye *cawar ɗo goyiŋko okin̰ji. Paa kat, ruwwinko, kelimko ho ziŋkiko yaa goyeŋ ko paa di okin̰co bal oorne nam ƴiriy ta yeepin̰ji ka *Rabbinte Iisa Masi.
Ŋaar kaak koliŋko-ak, kaawoy rakki di, ho ka seener, ŋaa necin taat ŋa kaawtu.
Gem kol siŋtay, indonni Buŋ oki.
Ooyon̰co ɗo siŋta dakina iŋ gine ka cuuɗ ar siŋta kuuk tacco rakki.
Iŋ siŋ ku Rabbiner, nu kaawaako : garkiyon maktumne-an ɗo uŋco ka siŋta okin̰co.
Buŋ yaako barkiyiŋko iŋ barkin ta Rabbinte Iisa Masi ! Nu ooyko dakina.

footnotes.text: Wer ka gase kaawor ɗo Ezaayi 59.17.
‛gee kuuk ginno gudurre’ : Anne-aŋ raka kaawe ɗo bi ka gee kuuk gudurrico wala imaanco sooɗa.
